scope: Source/method readiness only. Frontend implementation status must be re-audited on the Codex candidate commit.

status_meaning.ready: Current frozen data/method supports component for at least one edition with normal gating.
status_meaning.gated: Supported only when per-edition/per-group evidence requirements are met; UI must expose empty/method state.
status_meaning.blocked_by_evidence: Current approved public evidence cannot support the component as described.
status_meaning.frontend_pending: Method/data contract exists but Codex candidate UI has not yet been verified.

components.name: KPI/status/completion
components.evidence: All 27 editions; denominator tests distinguish registered/known-started/finished.

components.name: Finish histogram
components.evidence: All editions; 15-minute bins reconcile to exact finishers.

components.name: Finish percentiles
components.evidence: Per selected field; median n>=5, quartiles n>=10, deciles n>=20.

components.name: Sex overview/completion
components.evidence: Only source-supported F/M; unknown retained separately.

components.name: Class distribution
components.evidence: Source class strings available; no inferred class from age.

components.name: Status + field flow
components.evidence: Flow uses observed TIME only; missing passage is not DNF.

components.name: Finish time vs total place
components.evidence: FINISHED + public total place; profile click remains frontend concern.

components.name: Observed target time to placing
components.evidence: Can map to current-edition observed finish distribution; must not be future forecast.

components.name: DNF last observed checkpoint
components.evidence: 128 DNF; exact last TIME when available, otherwise unknown station.

components.name: Placement journey
components.evidence: Requires >=2 real placement observations; never synthesize start rank.

components.name: Closing strength
components.evidence: Requires positive real final segment pair.

components.name: Age / source age class
components.evidence: Use exact source age when present; never infer exact age from class text.

components.name: Club/place groups
components.evidence: Source club/location strings only; small groups must expose n.

components.name: Segment median + Q25-Q75
components.evidence: Exact positive segment pairs; thresholds n>=5/10.

components.name: Q10-Q90 detail
components.evidence: Exact positive segment pairs; threshold n>=20.

components.name: Pace retention
components.evidence: Requires valid segment distance for pace. 2023 and 2024 trail43 Torrås→Almered fail the timing-km median-speed sanity screen (>20 km/h); keep TIME analytics but suppress unverified pace/retention there.

components.name: Women/men segment pacing
components.evidence: Per-sex n enforced; 2023 43 km two sparse segments F=4/M=4.

components.name: Up to five analysis groups
components.evidence: Allowed only with source group + exact segment pairs; n visible.

components.name: Group x segment heatmap
components.evidence: Empty cell means insufficient evidence, never zero pace.

components.name: Field finish progression
components.evidence: Uses actual FINISHED denominator and finish times.

components.name: Field spread through controls
components.evidence: Only source TIME observations; population changes must be shown.

components.name: Course intelligence
components.evidence: Separate dimensions only; geometry-dependent measures only on authorized route editions.

components.name: Elevation profile
components.evidence: Five organizer display routes exist; public historical result UI route link currently only authorized where edition route_file permits.

components.name: Historical participation/status
components.evidence: Nine source years; 2020 absent, not zero.

components.name: Historical performance trends
components.evidence: Requires explicit whole-course comparison group; current participant candidate routes are not promoted.

components.name: Year fingerprint/records
components.evidence: Participation can span family; performance index requires verified comparable years.

components.name: Historical women/men share
components.evidence: Source sex only; unknown retained, coverage visible.

components.name: Results database
components.evidence: 27 edition bundles, 3272 rows; sort/filter/pagination UI remains frontend verification.

components.name: Official passages profile
components.evidence: Only source TIME rows; missing remains missing.

components.name: Runner segment + relative performance
components.evidence: Segment TIME/relative performance is source-valid on real pairs; min/km only where segment-distance capability passes. 2023/2024 trail43 Torrås→Almered are time-only until distance evidence is improved.

components.name: Segment lab
components.evidence: Per-segment readiness matrix and provenance available.

components.name: Direct comparison
components.evidence: Same RaceEdition real results; textual finish compare without route, segment/map compare only with common observed anchors + authorized route.

components.name: Race plan
components.evidence: Observed relative median n>=5 per effective segment; explicit distance-only fallback; exact total-time normalization.

components.name: Course versions/source
components.evidence: Five checksum-locked organizer GPX; explicit 2025/26 reuse rules; participant candidates kept unpromoted.

components.name: Historical years
components.evidence: Nine years and course/source status available.

components.name: Class/age/club
components.evidence: Source-supported groups only; frontend presentation pending Codex.

components.name: Source/coverage inventory
components.evidence: Edition counts, split coverage, station coverage, route/source fingerprints and JSON audit artifacts exist.

components.name: Overview map
components.evidence: Authorized local route required; timing distance must stay distinct from GPX display distance.

components.name: Historical route comparison
components.evidence: No pair of separately approved historical public route assets currently available for authoritative two-year overlay; participant candidates remain candidates.

components.name: Synchronized segment/course map
components.evidence: Authorized route + selected effective segment; source anchors only.

components.name: Runner Replay
components.evidence: At least two real timing anchors + authorized route; interpolation only between anchors; no old-course borrowing.

components.name: Map duel
components.evidence: Same edition, authorized route, >=2 real anchors per runner. Current first-draft 2025 43 km two-person scrub is browser-tested.

components.name: Neutral map fallback
components.evidence: Source rule is clear: no other edition route may be substituted; visual fallback must be verified on Codex candidate.

components.name: Interactive mini-map + elevation
components.evidence: 2025 route-enabled editions supported; bidirectional scrub tested in first draft.

components.name: Sex-separated podiums
components.evidence: Actual observed count only; 2016 ultra85 women has exactly two finishers.

components.name: Individual runner analysis
components.evidence: Real segments, placement journey and relative stats contracts exist; UI richness pending Codex.

components.name: Personal race plan
components.evidence: Effective source-observed segment axis; Tostared metadata-only bridge rule; exact target total.

components.name: Compare 2 races/results
components.evidence: Same-edition two-person route/elevation bidirectional scrub tested in first draft.
